title: ProvisionResponse
description: Response body returned by the provider after successfully provisioning or updating an extension resource.

id.description: The provider's unique identifier for this extension resource.

name.description: Human-readable name for the provisioned resource.

config.description: Environment variables to inject into the user's Fly App. Keys are variable names and values are the corresponding secrets or connection strings.

fly_app_name.description: If the provider runs a Fly App to serve this extension, specify its name here to enable Flycast routing from the customer's private network.
